module fsm_3state (
    input clk, reset,
    output [1:0] state
);

reg [1:0] state;
assign state = state;

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset) begin
        state <= 2'b0;
    end else begin
        case (state)
            2'b01: state <= 2'b10; // 1 -> 2
            2'b10: state <= 2'b11; // 2 -> 3
            2'b11: state <= 2'b01; // 3 -> 1
            default: state <= 2'b01; // 0 -> 1
        endcase
    end
end

endmodule

    input  [3:0] in,
    output [1:0] out,
    output       valid
);

    assign valid = |in;  // Valid signal is high if any input is active
    
    assign out[1] = in[3] | in[2];  // High when D3 or D2 (with higher priority) is active
    assign out[0] = in[3] | (in[1] & ~in[2]); // High when D3 or D1 (with higher priority) is active

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input reset,
  output reg [3:0] q
);

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset) begin
      q <= 4'b0;
    end else begin
      if (q == 4'd9) begin
        q <= 4'b0;
      end else begin
        q <= q + 1'b1;
      end
    end
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input resetn,
  input [1:0] byteena,
  input [15:0] d,
  output reg [15:0] q
);

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (resetn) begin
      case (byteena)
        2'b00:   q <= 16'h0000; // OB: Reset
        2'b01:   q <= 16'h3400; // DI: Set output to 0x3400
        2'b10:   q <= d;      // ND: Use external data
        default: q <= q;       // Default: Retain previous value
      endcase
    end
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input enable,
  input S,
  input A,
  input B,
  input C,
  output reg Z
);

  reg [5:0] stack;

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (enable) begin
      stack <= {stack[4:0], S}; // Shift left, new value in LSB
    end
  end

  always @(*) begin
    if (!A) begin
      Z = stack[5];
    end else if (B) begin
      Z = stack[0];
    end else begin
      Z = C;
    end
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input shift_ena,
  input count_ena,
  input data,
  output reg [3:0] q
);

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    case ({shift_ena, count_ena})
      2'b00: q <= q;         // No change
      2'b01: q <= q - 1;      // Decrease
      2'b10: q <= q + 1;      // Increase
      2'b11: q <= q + (data ? 4'd1 : 4'd3); // Increase by 1 or 3
    endcase
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input areset,
  input load,
  input ena,
  input [3:0] data,
  output reg [3:0] q
);

always @(posedge clk or posedge areset) begin
  if (areset) begin
    q <= 4'b0;
  end else begin
    if (load) begin
      q <= data;
    end else if (ena) begin
      q <= {1'b0, q[3:1]};
    end
  end
end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input a,
  output reg [2:0] q
);

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (a) begin
      q <= 3'b100; // Reset to 4 (100)
    end else begin
      // Convert to BCD, subtract 1, then add 3 (modulo 6)
      q <= ((q - 3'd1) + 3'd3) & 3'd5;
    end
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input  [3:0] in,
  output [3:0] out_both,
  output [3:0] out_any,
  output [3:0] out_different
);

  assign out_both = in & in;    // AND of each bit with itself (result: 0000)
  assign out_any = in | in;    // OR of each bit with itself (result: 1111)
  assign out_different = in ^ in;    // XOR of each bit with itself (result: 0000, but assuming independent random assignment)

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input [2:0] y,
  input w,
  output reg Y1
);

  always @* begin
    case (y)
      3'b100: Y1 = w;  // Condition 1: 100
      3'b111: Y1 = 1'b1; // Condition 2: 111
      default: Y1 = 1'b0;
    endcase
  end

endmodule
